name: Algorithm
description: A step-by-step procedure for solving a problem or performing a computation

name: Function
description: A reusable block of code that performs a specific task / A mathematical relation between sets where each input has exactly one output

name: Loop
description: A programming construct that repeats a block of code / A repeated section of music

name: Array
description: A data structure that stores a collection of elements in contiguous memory locations

name: String
description: A sequence of characters in programming / A vibrating element on musical instruments

name: Class
description: A blueprint for creating objects in object-oriented programming

name: Method
description: A function that is associated with an object or class in programming

name: Derivative
description: A measure of how a function changes as its input changes; the rate of change

name: Integral
description: A mathematical concept representing the area under a curve or the accumulation of quantities

name: Theorem
description: A mathematical statement that has been proven based on previously established statements

name: Axiom
description: A statement or proposition that is accepted as self-evidently true without proof

name: Proof
description: A logical argument demonstrating the truth of a mathematical statement

name: Limit
description: A value that a function or sequence approaches as the input approaches some value

name: Tangent
description: A line that touches a curve at a single point without crossing it / A trigonometric function

name: Chord
description: A group of notes played simultaneously in music / A line segment joining two points on a curve

name: Scale
description: A series of notes ordered by pitch in music / A system of measurement or proportion

name: Sequence
description: A series of musical phrases or a pattern in music production / An ordered list of elements in mathematics

name: Bridge
description: A contrasting section in a song / A structure that spans physical obstacles

name: Organ
description: A keyboard musical instrument / A group of tissues performing specific biological functions

name: Nerve
description: A bundle of fibers that transmits signals between the brain and body parts

name: Tissue
description: A group of cells that work together to perform a specific function in organisms

name: Cell
description: The basic structural and functional unit of living organisms / A basic unit of data storage in spreadsheets or arrays

name: Membrane
description: A thin layer of tissue that covers or lines parts of the body

name: Vessel
description: A tube that carries blood or lymph through the body

name: Spine
description: The vertebral column in anatomy / A main load-bearing element in architecture

name: Beam
description: A structural element that resists loads applied to its axis

name: Column
description: A vertical structural element that transmits weight to the foundation / A vertical division in a table or database

name: Arch
description: A curved structural element that spans an opening

name: Foundation
description: The lowest load-bearing part of a building / The base or basis of a mathematical system

name: Frame
description: The load-bearing skeleton of a building structure / A data structure or single unit of data transmission in programming

name: Tempo
description: The speed or pace at which a musical piece is played

name: Harmony
description: The combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce chords and chord progressions

name: Melody
description: A sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying; the main tune of a musical piece

name: Rhythm
description: A pattern of regular or irregular pulses in music created by the occurrence of strong and weak beats
